note: Published paths never move: global-law mounts this repo at france/national/acts and its case-law overlays key on these paths. New sources land in new top-level folders.

folders.holds: Constitution of 1958 (and the 1946/1848 articles LEGI keeps in force), every article version
the 77 codes consolidated by LEGI, one file per article, every version
every other consolidated text (lois, ordonnances, décrets, arrêtés…)
texts as published in the Journal officiel (Lois et Décrets), unconsolidated; nominative measures as metadata only
national collective agreements, every article version

Assemblée nationale (dossiers, documents, amendments, scrutins, questions and answers, comptes rendus, 14th-17th legislatures; archives of 1958-2002), Sénat (texts, dossiers since 1977, questions since 1978, amendments, scrutins, rapports, debates), Légifrance dossiers législatifs, JO Débats 2011-2017
folders.source: data.assemblee-nationale.fr, archives.assemblee-nationale.fr, data.senat.fr, DILA DOLE and Debats

folders.holds: ministerial circulars and instructions as put online, with their PDF text; abrogations and updates as further files
company collective agreements as published; home addresses, birth data and social-security numbers not reproduced
index of the case-law repositories (decisions are kept in lexifina/france-<court>-caselaw)
folders.source: DILA CASS, INCA, CAPP, JADE, CONSTIT

folders.holds: acts of local authorities published as open data (délibérations, arrêtés, procès-verbaux); private persons metadata only
folders.source: INSEE COG 2026, BANATIC, data.gouv.fr (SCDL délibérations and other local-acts datasets of public bodies)
